response_text: Omega‑3 fatty acids and related lipids may make platelets more “slippery,” reducing aggregation and potentially influencing mood by affecting neurotransmitter release. They are powerful regulators of inflammation, producing metabolites such as resolvins from DHA that help resolve inflammatory responses. EPA‑derived molecules, including leukotrienes and prostaglandins, also modulate platelet function and inflammation, contributing to the overall beneficial effects of omega‑3s.
